metadata.scenario: A new customer claims they were overcharged for their first subscription fee compared to the advertised rate. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Helen Johnson. I'm calling about a billing issue I have. Hi Helen, it's great to hear from you! What seems to be the problem? Well, I just received my first subscription fee, and it looks higher than what was advertised on your website. I'm sorry to hear that. Can you tell me what the amount was charged? It was $150, but I thought it was supposed to be around $125 for the services I selected. I understand your concern, Helen. Let me pull up your account to check the details. Sure, take your time. I just want to make sure I'm being billed correctly. Thank you for your patience. It looks like there may have been an error in processing your subscription. Oh no, I really hope that can be corrected. Absolutely, we will make it right. I'll need to escalate this issue to our billing department. How long do you think that will take? Typically, it can take up to 24 to 48 hours for them to review and adjust the charge. Alright, I just don't want to be overcharged again. I completely understand. I’ll ensure they prioritize this. Can I take down your best contact number for follow-up? Sure, it’s the same number I called from: +13165552580. Perfect. We'll reach out to you as soon as we have an update. Thank you, Margaret. I appreciate you handling this for me. You're welcome! Also, since you’re currently receiving physical therapy, would you be interested in any additional services, like companion care? Hmm, I hadn’t thought about it. What does that involve? Companion care includes social interaction, light housekeeping, and meal preparation. It could be helpful if you need extra support during recovery. That sounds interesting. I’ll think about it. Great! Let me know if you have any questions or want to explore that option. Will do, thanks again for your help today, Margaret. My pleasure, Helen! Have a wonderful day! You too, bye! Goodbye!
